about: Derived roles (#417 AC7). The look adds two palette colors and four roles: blue and yellow name them, green mixes them halfway in OKLab and sky is blue made lighter by 0.2. `lighter` is recorded from this definition, which the README states: in OKLab, L' = L + by × (1 − L), with a and b kept. Every number below is the OKLab of the sRGB colors as the M1/M2 matrices of Ottosson (2020) give them, computed in f64 by tests/acceptance/417/helpers.ts's formulas.
